optimizedDescription.value: Pure bounded traversal computes filtered deterministic blast radius, risk, hierarchy, owner-qualified impact, and coverage.

optimizedContext.value:
# Traversal
## Rules
- `getUpstream` follows reverse `CALLS`; `getDownstream` forward `CALLS`; default `maxDepth: 3`; 1-indexed levels. Track visited, keep shallowest depth, terminate cycles.
- `TraversalOptions`: `maxDepth` 3, `includeFiles` true adds `IMPORTS`. `TraversalResult`: `root`, `levels: Map<number, SymbolNode[]>`, unique `totalCount`, `truncated` when depth cap may hide results.
- BFS batches each frontier through `GraphStore` symbol/relation operations: no per-symbol/type calls; dedupe ids before one logical node batch. File/multi-file impact, change detection, per-symbol aggregation use fixed bounded concurrency independent of width/input size. Multi-file shares memoized read view and budget. Preserve direction/depth/cycles/order/evidence/counts/risk; wide graphs cannot fail with `StoreOverloadError` solely from volume.
- Hotspots perform one logical `getIncomingSymbolRelations` for all candidates and `EXTENDS`, `IMPLEMENTS`, `OVERRIDES`, fold counts in memory; no candidate-by-candidate query. Preserve scoring/filtering/order/risk.
- `analyzeImpact(store,target,direction,maxDepth=3)` returns target; depth-1 direct, depth-2 indirect, depth-3+ transitive counts; risk; unique files; `AffectedSymbol{id,name,filePath,line,depth}`; matching processes. `maxDepth` also bounds `IMPORTS` BFS.
- Optional impact filter applies across symbol/file/multi-file/spec/public-binding: result types closed to `files | symbols | specs`, symbol kinds, included/excluded canonical workspaces. Empty include admits all; exclusion wins. Kind only affects symbol results. Admitted symbols may still support file/spec computation when symbols not requested.
- Apply eligibility before returned collections/counts. Derive risk, depths, files, coverage evidence, ordering from admitted traversal evidence. Materialize only requested categories; never delivery-layer post-filter. Filtering precedes limits and uses `GraphStore` filtered-impact reads, not unrestricted fetch/discard.
- Every `ImpactResult` has deterministic `affectedSpecs`. When requested, derive from `COVERS_SYMBOL`/`COVERS_FILE` over admitted evidence; otherwise `[]`. Specs-only still traverses necessary symbol/file evidence.
- First-class directional edges: `CALLS`, `CONSTRUCTS`, `USES_TYPE`, `EXTENDS`, `IMPLEMENTS`, `OVERRIDES`; all affect depth/risk/symbol/file aggregation. Requirement-aware views may add specs via coverage.
- Risk: `LOW` 0–2 direct and no indirect; `MEDIUM` 3–5 direct or any indirect; `HIGH` 6+ direct or 10+ total; `CRITICAL` 20+ total or target in 3+ flows.
- `analyzeFileImpact` loads file symbols via `findSymbols({filePath})`, analyzes each, dedupes at shallowest depth, unions files, preserves per-symbol results, takes max risk. `analyzeFilesImpact` aggregates lists, sums depth counts, max risk.
- `FileImpactResult.coveringSpecs`: batched reverse `COVERS_FILE`/`COVERS_SYMBOL`; one spec with minimum depth plus every distinct `{kind:file|symbol,target,depth}`. Inputs/defined symbols depth 0; reached evidence shallowest 1..`maxDepth`; all multi-file inputs depth 0. Sort by min depth, spec id, evidence depth/kind/target. File coverage independent; symbol coverage augments. Open-graph evidence only.
- `analyzeSpecImpact` uses `DEPENDS_ON`, `COVERS_FILE`, `COVERS_SYMBOL`. Upstream returns dependent specs plus coverage of target/transitive dependents; downstream returns dependencies plus files/symbols reached within depth.
- `detectChanges` finds changed-file symbols, bounded upstream traverses, aggregates symbols/files/risk/summary.
- Resolve selector to one canonical logical target before traversal. Unqualified: case-exact, then case-insensitive exact only; no prefix/component/text widening. Unique traverses; multiple => bounded deterministic ambiguity, no traversal. Qualified/full occurrence selectors retain exact semantics.
- Owner-qualified impact calls shared resolver; stored `qualified_name` match requires no file. One logical member => traverse only it; several equal matches => report all, traverse none; zero => no terminal-name fallback. Preserve exact public-binding/location selectors. Traversal consumes proven symbol id and never parses human syntax.
- Public-export impact accepts one public-binding identity; separately returns exact surface/export consumers including re-exports, and all canonical-symbol dependents. Retain binding, canonical target, ordered chain. Ambiguity never merges/selects.
- Hierarchy preserves direction/language precedence for contracts, overrides, inherited members, traits, mixins, embedding, promotion, provable interface satisfaction. Count logical symbol once across declarations. Ordering backend-deterministic, indexed, bounded, cycle-safe.
- All traversal functions are stateless, read-only, in `domain/services/`; injected `GraphStore`; no lifecycle/state/mutation.
## Constraints
- Default depth 3, caller-overridable; fixed risk thresholds.
- Shallowest-depth cycle dedupe mandatory.
- Bounded batching/concurrency across graph width/input size.
- Read-only `GraphStore`; no `@specd/core` dependency.
